title: Conversational Ops Assistant for Trace Extraction and SLA Rotation
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Background: We routinely see incidents where high tail latency or transient error spikes originate from complex multi-tenant routing and cache thrashing. Current PD/Slack payloads include basic links and a short summary, but responders spend the first 10-25 minutes locating the most relevant traces, timeline slices, and suspect commits. Goal: build a conversational ops assistant that enriches PagerDuty and Slack alerts with curated trace extracts, latency/error badges, and on-demand runbook suggestions, and that orchestrates rotational SLA logic (notify alternative responders when SLAs are at risk).

Scope/Deliverables:
- Alert enrichment middleware that attaches a prioritized evidence bundle (compact trace snippets, top spans, top contributing services, error histograms) to PD incidents and Slack threads.
- Conversational slash-command in Slack (/ops-assist) allowing on-call to request additional context: correlated logs, recent model-serving kernel changes, and suggestion of next remediation steps from our runbook library.
- SLA rotation engine that watches incident age + latency trend; if escalation thresholds are hit, automatically pages alternate group and posts a sticky Slack message with suggested rollback or fallback model variants.
- Auto-postmortem seed generator: generate a draft postmortem (metadata, timeline, evidence links, suggested owner, and a short incident blameless summary) and attach to the incident when the incident is resolved or marked critical.

Success criteria (MVP):
- Median time-to-first-evidence during triage reduced from ~12m to <=4m on paged incidents.
- >80% of PD incidents get a generated evidence bundle attached within 2 minutes of firing.
- No false escalations from SLA rotation in >95% of simulated runs during QA.
- Generated postmortems reach 60% completeness (based on a checklist) and are accepted by on-call in 50%+ of trials.

Non-goals for MVP: automatic remediation, full natural-language incident summarization beyond a 3-sentence blameless summary.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: pile-on alerts will trigger many enrichment requests and overload the enrichment workers. Mitigation: rate-limit per-service and provide a cached evidence bundle for identical alert signatures.
- Risk: over-trusting conversational suggestions may cause noisy runbook triggering. Mitigation: conversational outputs are advisory; throttle any runbook-trigger action behind a two-click confirmation in Slack.

Acceptance criteria:
- Integration tests that simulate PD incident creation and validate attachments (trace snippets, histogram images, and runbook suggestions) within SLA.
- E2E QA runbooks for on-call to exercise Slack slash-command flows and SLA rotation scenarios.
- Security review signed off for attachments and KMS usage for any secret references.

Rollout plan:
1) Feature-flagged internal alpha for Platform and SRE teams only.
2) Collect metrics and iterate on evidence prioritization rules for 2 weeks.
3) Gradual opt-in for high-usage customers on Dedicated and Private workloads.

Observability and metrics to track:
- evidence_bundle_latency_ms (p95)
- fraction_incidents_with_bundle
- sla_rotation_actions_count and false_positive_rate
- time_to_first_evidence_median

updates: 2026-03-02: Spike complete — proof-of-concept collects top-5 spans via trace sampling and produces a 3-line summary. Sampling heuristics chosen: highest duration * error weight.
2026-03-04: Design review with SRE/Platform accepted evidence-bundle schema. Decided to use signed, time-limited presigned links for large trace artifacts to avoid payload bloat in PD messages.
2026-03-06: Implemented Slack slash-command endpoint; initial responses return a short list of correlated logs. Need to formalize RBAC for who can run heavy aggregation queries.
2026-03-09: SLA rotation prototype emits alternate-page events to PD test org. Found edge-case where scheduled maintenance windows should suppress rotation — added maintenance window check.
2026-03-12: QA session produced 3 failures due to stale cache; fixed cache invalidation and added a cache TTL and signature for reuse.

2026-03-14: First internal alpha rollout toggled on for Platform team. Observing evidence_bundle_latency_p95=1.8s for small traces; larger bundles around 4.2s. Next: optimize trace extraction pipeline and add backpressure for extreme firehose events.
comments: Priya Nair (SRE): 'The proof-of-concept already saved ~8 minutes during the last page — love the SLA rotation logic.'
Connor Li (Product): 'Please ensure runbook suggestions highlight the minimal blast radius and rollbacks first.'
Evelyn Park (Security): 'We need to confirm no PII is included in attachments; please add a scrubber stage.'
Design note: include a compact visual badge (green/yellow/red) representing latency band and error-rate trend for quick scanning in Slack threads.
